name: crouch_walk
note: (anim-rework S4 keys, real-world standard, keyed by hand; never traced; M6) The crouched holstered walk: weight between the feet, short steps (about 42 cm), knees bent 70-90 deg and tracking over the toes, the shins forward of the ankles in stance, feet landing close to the line under the hips (legs add 2 deg: about 5 cm a foot), no duck-waddle; the hips 22-25 cm below standing with a small bob (lowest at the strike); the trunk leans forward (pelvis 16, chest 24 deg) with the head up; the arms hang along the body (in the world 8 back to 6 forward), elbows 16-22 deg, a small swing against the legs, no forward reach. Phase 0 is the left foot strike; keys 0-0.375 are mirrored. Angles in degrees in the body frame (x right, y up, z forward): pitch about x (+ the top forward), yaw about y (+ turns right), roll about z (+ the right side up). Pelvis offsets in cm from the standing rest (dy is the full crouch depth, so the Blender preview stands on the floor; the game adds a clip's dy to its own crouch drop: slice 4 wiring takes dy relative to the clip mean or drops the procedural crouch, S4-KEYS.md). Arms: flex (+ forward, in the chest frame: the world angle is flex minus the chest pitch), abd (+ out), elbow (+ bent), inward (the forearm turned in toward the midline); wrist (anim-rig, RIG.md) yaw / pitch / roll in the forearm frame, right hand as written, the left mirrored. Legs (the Blender preview and the track only: the game's feet come from the foot planner): flex (+ the knee forward), add (+ the foot in toward the midline), knee (+ bent), ankle (+ the toes up).
